text:
maria (Marketing): quick sync — upcoming virtual event (Americas timezone). Need confirmation on Zoom recording, Spanish interpretation track, captions export, and our post-event lead flow. Key deliverables: cloud + local backup, separate speaker audio files, 3 social clips, SRT, and a Spanish-only replay asset.

devon (Ops): on it. Zoom settings we'll toggle: 'Record to cloud', 'Separate audio file per participant', and turn on 'Language interpretation'. I'll set host permissions so ops can access recordings, and run a local OBS recording as fallback. :white_check_mark:

samira (Marketing Ops): registration page items to enforce: company, title (select), use-case (short paragraph), GDPR consent checkbox, opt-in for benchmark emails. Add hidden UTMs: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign. Confirmation page should show: short thank-you, expected replay timing, and CTA to trial.

kai (Demand Gen): HubSpot routing plan: add everyone to list 'webinar_2026_q1_virtual', set contact property 'interest_topic=benchmarks'. Scoring: +10 for attended, +5 for viewed replay. Post-event cadence: immediate replay email (T+1h) to registrants; deeper follow-up (T+24h) to attendees with clip + benchmark PDF.

maria (Marketing): clips — ops, please provide three edit-ready segments: ~30s, ~60s, ~90s. Prefer separate speaker tracks so editors can isolate voices. Export an SRT and a plain transcript.

devon (Ops): suggested pipeline: cloud recording -> copy to GDrive path 'webinars/2026-03-10_virtual-benchmarks' -> run clipper toolchain to produce 30/60/90s versions with burned captions -> place outputs in content review folder. Retention: recordings kept 90 days by default. Example clipper command:
```
./clipper --source recording.mkv --captions recording.srt --lengths 30,60,90 --out /gdrive/webinars/2026-03-10/clips
```

samira (Marketing Ops): T+1h email draft pointers: subject 'Replay: highlights + TL;DR from <event name>', body: 1-line thanks, 3 bullets with key takeaways, link to full replay, embed 1 short clip, CTA 'Start Redwood trial — 14 days free'. Attach benchmark one-pager for people who chose 'benchmark' in the form.

kai (Demand Gen): UTMs: include utm_content=benchmark_onepager on the PDF link. Lead assignment: if employee_count > 100 => assign to AE-enterprise queue; otherwise => SDR-inbound. Also set lead_source=webinar and campaign=2026-q1-benchmarks.

maria (Marketing): Spanish asset question — will ops be able to export a Spanish-only replay (audio channel swapped to interpretation) so we can surface 'Recurso en Español' on the confirmation/thank-you page?

devon (Ops): yes. Zoom adds interpretation as an alternate audio channel on export. We'll generate replay_es.mp4 and upload it to the same GDrive folder. Storage overhead minimal for one event; we'll remove after 90 days unless retention extended.

eventbot: Recording scheduled: Wed 2026-03-10 15:00 UTC. Cloud recording enabled. Reserved folder: gdrive.redwood/webinars/2026-03-10_virtual-benchmarks.

samira (Marketing Ops): action items — I'll own the checklist in Notion: 1) devon: confirm OBS fallback + upload script 2) devon: export speaker-only audio, SRT, and clips 3) kai: HubSpot list + assignment rules 4) maria/content: final edit + benchmark one-pager + social assets 5) devon: Spanish-only replay export 6) samira: update reg page + email templates. I'll post the Notion link here by EOD and tag owners.

maria (Marketing): I'll draft the one-page benchmark narrative (top 3 metrics, short methodology blurb, CTA for cost/latency eval) and drop it in content.

kai (Demand Gen): small ask — add utm_content=clip_social when we publish short clips so GA shows clip performance.

devon (Ops): heads-up: if anyone wants to rehearse interpretation or check audio routing, I can spin a staging Zoom today at 17:00 UTC. Ping me and I'll invite you.

maria (Marketing): perfect — thanks all. Samira: once the Notion checklist is live, paste the link and I'll mark tasks done. :rocket:
